lyon-beaujolais-golden-stone-roads.title: Lyon · Beaujolais Golden-Stone Roads
lyon-beaujolais-golden-stone-roads.slogan: A 161 km loop out of Anse
lyon-beaujolais-golden-stone-roads.story: Vineyards, ochre villages and short-radius rhythm north of Lyon. Out of Anse and back again: 161 km, roughly 2 h 47 in the saddle. The stops in between: Oingt golden village, Beaujeu vineyard roads and Mâcon river. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.

sections.advice: This Oingt golden village → Beaujeu vineyard roads stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Beaujeu vineyard roads → Mâcon river food is the reward section in Lyon. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
